page.title: Connectors
page.empty: No connectors yet. Add one to start reading a service.

activity.title: Activity
activity.empty: Syncs that record something or fail show up here.

deleteBody.atlassian: Its Atlassian account is removed with it, along with any action item links made through it. The token stays valid on Atlassian until you revoke it there. What it recorded stays on the timeline.
deleteBody.github: Its GitHub account is removed with it, along with any coding session or action item link that uses its token. The token stays valid on GitHub until you revoke it there.
deleteBody.browser: Its browser is removed with it, signing it out of everything it was signed in to on this host. What it recorded stays on the timeline.
deleteBody.token: Its key is forgotten. The key stays valid with its provider until you revoke it there. What it recorded stays on the timeline.

jira.name: Jira
jira.description: Issues on a Jira Cloud site, bounded to the projects and boards you pick, read with an Atlassian API token.

confluence.name: Confluence
confluence.description: Pages and comments in the spaces you pick, read with an Atlassian API token.

github.name: GitHub
github.description: Issues and pull requests, read through a personal access token.

outlook.name: Outlook
outlook.description: Your Outlook inbox, read through a browser Elysium runs, which you sign in to once. Reading never marks your mail read.

gmail.name: Gmail
gmail.description: Your Gmail inbox, read through a browser Elysium runs, which you sign in to once. Reading never marks your mail read.

teams.name: Teams
teams.description: Your Teams chats and channels, read through a browser Elysium runs, which you sign in to once. Unread chats, mentions, and replies in your threads land in your inbox.

fireflies.name: Fireflies
fireflies.description: Your recorded meetings, read with your Fireflies API key and cut into segments on each project's timeline.

slack.name: Slack
slack.description: Your Slack workspaces, read through a browser Elysium runs, which you sign in to once. Direct messages, mentions, and thread replies land in your inbox.

youtrack.name: YouTrack
youtrack.description: Issues and comments on a YouTrack Cloud site, read with your own permanent token.
